designationHistory.name: Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge was established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act through a license agreement with the State of Florida's flood control district; it was later renamed for Arthur R. Marshall.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; license agreement with the Central and Southern Florida Flood Control District (now South Florida Water Management District)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Arthur R. Marshall Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Arthur R. Marshall Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 1379): refuge authorized under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act and created by a 1951 license agreement with the flood control district

review.note: Established 1951 by license agreement (CCP gives Jan. 1, 1951 as the authorized start). Original name Loxahatchee NWR.
